OC SASA presents Garba! Garba is a traditional Gujarati folk dance celebrated during Navratri, bringing us together through music and dance

About this Event

OC SASA is proud to host OC SASA Garba!Garba is a traditional Gujarati folk dance celebrated during Navratri, bringing people together through music, dance, and community. Join us for a night filled with music, dancing, culture, and celebration as we come together to celebrate our South Asian heritage!
This year, OC SASA is collaborating with numerous schools across Orange County and beyond, including schools in Anaheim, Riverside, and more! We’re excited to bring students from different communities together for an unforgettable night of Garba, connection, and celebration.
🎟️ Make sure to buy your tickets soon, as we expect them to sell out!
We can’t wait to bring OC SASA Garba to life and celebrate with all of you. Get ready to dance, meet new people, and celebrate our culture together!
